summary: Hanania argues from base rates that AI’s benefits are large and much current alarm is overblown, while granting that AI might pose a real danger.

statements.quote: My view on AI doom is the probability is low. Defaulting to base rates is a good strategy, and here the base rates say we’ll be fine.
I predict that there won’t be job loss that is high by historical standards that most economists conclude is due to AI.
It seems like we’re underrating the possibility that more intelligence at our fingertips is just good.
I’m glad hysteria about AI has displaced global warming hysteria. AI might actually pose a danger.
This doesn’t mean that we shouldn’t be worried at all, but it does suggest that some of the coverage may be too alarmist.
statements.venue: Essay, What if We’re Already “Solving” Alignment?
